nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: XC6206 LDO regulator. Converts USB_VBUS (5V) to VCC_3V3 system rail. VIN (pin 3) connects to USB_VBUS, VOUT (pin 2) provides VCC_3V3, VSS (pin 1) connects to GND. Bypass caps required on input and output. This module is the sole provider of the VCC_3V3 rail for downstream modules.

nodes.name: mcu_main
nodes.description: CH32V003 RISC-V MCU. VDD (pin 9) requires VCC_3V3, VSS (pin 7) connects to GND. This module owns the main logic and I2C bus master interface. I2C bus lines (SCL and SDA) are open-drain, requiring external pull-up resistors placed in this module. UART_TX and UART_RX pins are configured for communication with the USB-UART bridge. Unused GPIOs are available for future expansion.

nodes.name: PD7
nodes.description: GPIO, alt: NRST (active low reset). Must have pull-up or reset circuit.

nodes.name: PD1
nodes.description: GPIO, alt: SWIO (single-wire debug)/T1CH3N. Default debug pin.

nodes.name: usb_uart_bridge
nodes.description: CH340 USB to UART bridge. Provides USB connectivity and serial communication to the MCU. VCC (pin 16) and V3 (pin 4) connect to VCC_3V3. GND (pin 1) connects to GND. UD_P (pin 5) and UD_N (pin 6) are for USB data connection (requires termination resistors). XI (pin 7) and XO (pin 8) need an external crystal. This module consumes UART_RXD (pin 3) from the MCU and drives UART_TXD (pin 2) to the MCU.

nodes.name: GND
nodes.description: Ground. Connect to USB bus ground.

nodes.name: TXD
nodes.description: Serial data output to MCU RXD.

nodes.name: RXD
nodes.description: Serial data input from MCU TXD.

nodes.name: V3
nodes.description: Internal 3.3V regulator output. At 5V: connect 0.1uF cap to GND. At 3.3V: connect to VCC.

nodes.name: UD_P
nodes.description: USB D+ data line. Connect directly to USB connector.

nodes.name: UD_N
nodes.description: USB D- data line. Connect directly to USB connector.

nodes.name: CTS
nodes.description: MODEM Clear To Send, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DSR
nodes.description: MODEM Data Set Ready, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: RI
nodes.description: MODEM Ring Indicator, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DCD
nodes.description: MODEM Data Carrier Detect, active low. Leave unconnected if unused.

nodes.name: DTR
nodes.description: MODEM Data Terminal Ready, active low. Often used for MCU auto-reset.

nodes.name: RTS
nodes.description: MODEM Request To Send, active low. Often used for MCU boot mode.

nodes.name: R232
nodes.description: RS232 enable, active high. Built-in pull-down. Leave floating for TTL mode.

nodes.name: eeprom_config
nodes.description: AT24C256 256Kbit I2C EEPROM. Stores configuration data. Operates as an I2C slave on the shared I2C bus. Requires power (VCC) from VCC_3V3 and ground connection. Address pins (A0-A2) are tied via resistors to set I2C address; this module configures the address selection network. Write protect (WP) pin configuration is defined here.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: Address bit 0. Tie to GND or VCC. I2C address = 1010_A2_A1_A0.

nodes.name: A1
nodes.description: Address bit 1. Tie to GND or VCC.

nodes.name: A2
nodes.description: Address bit 2. Tie to GND or VCC. Up to 8 devices on one bus.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect. GND=write enabled, VCC=write inhibited.
